s1.syndrome_frame: Recurrent, painful, and tender skin lesions and ulcers with systemic inflammation and lymph node involvement
salient_findings: Recurrent ankle swelling and painful nodules on legs and feet
Painful leg ulcers with violaceous and purpuric borders
key_facts: 15-year history of recurrent ankle swelling and painful nodules
Symptoms worsened during two pregnancies
Nodules progressed to painful leg ulcers
Developed intermittent oral and vaginal ulcerations
Previous treatments included systemic corticosteroids and immunosuppressants
Elevated C-reactive protein and erythrocyte sedimentation rate
Mildly elevated C3 and hyperglycemia
Leukocytosis and venous stasis on Doppler ultrasound
Splenomegaly and lymph node involvement on systemic imaging
Atypical lymphocytic infiltrate on skin biopsy
Epidermal necrosis and fibrin thrombi on skin biopsy
Abnormal T-cell population with CD52 expression on flow cytometry

shortlist.label: Behcet's disease
shortlist.why_kept: Recurrent painful oral and genital ulcers, skin lesions, and systemic inflammation

shortlist.label: Polyarteritis nodosa
shortlist.why_kept: Painful nodules, leg ulcers, and systemic inflammation with elevated C-reactive protein and erythrocyte sedimentation rate

shortlist.label: Wegener's granulomatosis
shortlist.why_kept: Systemic inflammation, lymph node involvement, and skin lesions with atypical lymphocytic infiltrate on biopsy

shortlist.label: Lupus erythematosus
shortlist.why_kept: Recurrent skin lesions, oral and genital ulcers, and systemic inflammation with elevated C3 and hyperglycemia

shortlist.label: Pyoderma gangrenosum
shortlist.why_kept: Painful leg ulcers with violaceous and purpuric borders, and areas of eschar and fibrinous base

raw.rationale: The patient's symptoms of recurrent painful nodules, oral and vaginal ulcerations, and the progression to leg ulcers are consistent with Behcet's disease, which is characterized by a triad of recurrent oral ulcers, genital ulcers, and ocular inflammation, and can also involve the skin and vascular system.

rejected.label: Polyarteritis nodosa
rejected.why: While it can cause skin nodules and ulcers, the presence of oral and vaginal ulcerations and the specific pattern of skin lesions are more suggestive of Behcet's disease.

rejected.label: Wegener's granulomatosis
rejected.why: It typically presents with a combination of respiratory and renal symptoms, which are not mentioned in the vignette.

rejected.label: Lupus erythematosus
rejected.why: The patient's symptoms and laboratory findings do not show a clear pattern of autoimmune disease with specific antibodies or characteristic renal involvement.

rejected.label: Pyoderma gangrenosum
rejected.why: It is characterized by the development of a painful nodule or pustule that progresses to a ulcer, but the presence of oral and vaginal ulcerations and the specific pattern of skin lesions are more suggestive of Behcet's disease.
